1.consolidated_definition: pol. Constitución o programa de un partido político. Frecuente. DRAE: desde 1992. Su plataforma política era clara y precisa: declarar a Puerto Rico territorio de los Estados Unidos en preparación para ser parte de la unión americana (Silvestrini y )
1.en_consolidated_definition: Platform or program of a political party. Frequently used since 1992 (DRAE). Its political platform was clear and precise: to declare Puerto Rico a territory of the United States in preparation for becoming part of the American union (Silvestrini and ).
